input.text: The city council approved a $4.2 million budget for a new public library on Tuesday. The library will be built on Elm Street and is expected to open in 2028. Council member Rivera said the vote was the result of three years of community meetings. Opponents argued the money should go to road repairs instead.

expected.reference: The city council approved a $4.2 million budget for a new library on Elm Street, expected to open in 2028.

input.text: Version 3.0 of the Lumen app adds offline mode and cuts startup time by 40 percent. Users can now download playlists for listening without a connection. The update also removes support for Android 9. It is rolling out to all users this week.

expected.reference: Lumen 3.0 adds offline mode and makes startup 40 percent faster.

input.text: Researchers found that honeybees can learn to count up to four when trained with sugar rewards. The study tested 120 bees over six weeks. Bees that received rewards for correct choices improved accuracy from 50 to 80 percent. The authors say this suggests numerical ability is older in evolution than thought.

expected.reference: Researchers showed honeybees can learn to count up to four using sugar rewards.

input.text: A configuration change caused a 47-minute outage of the payments API on October 2. Requests failed with HTTP 503 errors across all regions. The team rolled back the change and added a canary stage to the deploy pipeline. No customer data was lost.

expected.reference: A configuration change caused a 47-minute payments API outage on October 2; it was rolled back.

input.text: Starting January 1, employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Teams must agree on two shared in-office days. Managers will review the policy after six months. Exceptions require approval from a director.

expected.reference: From January 1, employees can work remotely up to three days a week.

input.text: The Riverside Hawks won the regional championship 3-1 on Saturday. Striker Lena Ortiz scored twice in the second half. It is the club's first title since 2011. The team now advances to the national tournament in May.

expected.reference: The Riverside Hawks won the regional championship 3-1 on Saturday.
